title: Copilot code review environment is set up in copilot-code-review.yml
answers: where is the Copilot code review setup environment configured
which toolchains does the Copilot code reviewer have installed
how does Copilot code review run builds or tests in this repo
where do I change the Python or Node setup for the Copilot reviewer
body:
Copilot code review's setup environment is the `copilot-code-review` job in `.github/workflows/copilot-code-review.yml`, not a repo script.
The job runs a credential-free checkout (`persist-credentials: false`), then `./.github/actions/setup-python` with `pin-micro-version: false`, then `./.github/actions/setup-node`.
Triggers, job name, permissions (`contents: read`), cache policy and timeout live in the same file; keep them when editing the steps.
`.github/instructions/code-review.instructions.md` ("Verify When It's Cheap") points reviewers at this workflow file as the source of truth for what is installed.
applies: Changes to the Copilot code review toolchain or to the verification guidance the reviewer reads in this repo.
says: Automated pull request review fails because required Python or Node versions are missing.
Update the automated code review environment to install new language dependencies for verification.
The automated code reviewer cannot run build checks due to missing runtime setup.
Add new runtime toolchains so the automated pull request reviewer can run tests.
